headline: CheapCart announces a sale
summary: 20% off CheapCart packages for two days.
details: CheapCart is running a two-day neighbourhood promotion. Look for the sale price on its shelves.

headline: Oats go viral
summary: Oat prices rise 50% across stores today.
details: An online trend has everyone buying rolled oats, so they cost more today. The trend doesn't make oats any healthier than they were yesterday.

headline: Verdant & Co. closes for maintenance
summary: The store is closed today. Pantry food is unaffected.
details: Verdant & Co. is closed for maintenance today. You can still cook with what's in your pantry, or shop at another store. It reopens tomorrow.

headline: The bistro makes local news
summary: More visitors expected, plus a Verdant & Co. promotion.
details: A local feature has put the bistro in the news, so more people may drop by over the next two days. Verdant & Co. is celebrating with 10% off.

headline: CheapCart closes for restocking
summary: CheapCart is closed today. Pantry food is unaffected.
details: CheapCart is closed for a full restock today. Cook with what's in your pantry, or shop at another store. It reopens tomorrow.

headline: Harvest week arrives
summary: Fruit and vegetables are 30% cheaper at every store for two days.
details: Local farms are bringing in a big harvest. Fresh and frozen fruit and vegetables are on sale across town.

headline: Bean & lentil week
summary: Beans are 25% cheaper everywhere for two days.
details: Stores are celebrating beans and lentils with a two-day promotion. A good time to stock up on pantry staples.

headline: Lantern festival in town
summary: More visitors expected, and guests are in the mood for something sweet.
details: The lantern festival brings people out into the streets. Expect extra visitors, and plenty of requests for sweet dishes.

headline: A cold snap
summary: Guests are asking for hearty, comforting food.
details: Chilly weather has everyone craving something warm and filling. Hearty and comforting dishes will be popular for two days.

headline: Community nutrition workshop
summary: Sorting refunds are 50% higher for purchases today.
details: The community centre is running a food-label workshop today. Every correct sorting answer on today's purchases earns a bigger refund.

headline: CheapCart's freezer delivery is late
summary: CheapCart's back freezer is sold out today.
details: A delayed delivery truck has left CheapCart's freezer aisle empty for the day. Frozen foods will need to come from another store.

headline: Sweet potato shortage
summary: Sweet potatoes are sold out, and purple sweet potatoes cost 30% more.
details: A poor harvest has left stores short of sweet potatoes for two days. Purple sweet potatoes are still around, at a higher price.

headline: Heat wave
summary: Guests want cool, sweet treats, and fruit and vegetables bought today keep a day less.
details: A hot spell is rolling through town. Guests are asking for something sweet and cool, and fresh produce won't keep as long, so buy only what you'll cook soon.
